subject: Request: Non-standard commercial approval for NovaCorp - onboarding + premium support
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elenatorres@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: Non-standard commercial approval for NovaCorp - onboarding + premium support

Hi Lauren / Rishi —

Quick escalation for executive approval. NovaCorp is ready to commit to a 12-month contract but requires premium support included and a scoped integration (custom connector to their internal data lake). Summary below:

- Account: NovaCorp (Elena Torres)
- Proposed ARR (committed): $300,000/year
- List price: $370,000/year
- Ask: 20% one-year discount to hit $300k commitment + include Premium Support (P1 response SLA) for first year + cover up to 80 hours of integration work (SOW attached) as a one-time onboarding credit
- Why: NovaCorp is migrating several product lines and has a fast expansion signal (pilot across three business units in Q4). Competitor XYZ offered a deeper discount unless we include managed onboarding.

Attachments: NovaCorp_SOW_v1.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan_NovaCorp.xlsx, Order_Form_NovaCorp-20260710.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/54321

Decision requested: approval for the non-standard commercial terms (discount + onboarding credit + included Premium Support) or guidance on alternative concessions we can offer. Impact if approved: commits $300k ARR with expected expansion in 9–12 months. Impact if denied: high risk of deal loss to competitor.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

—Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elenatorres@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Non-standard commercial approval for NovaCorp - onboarding + premium support

On Fri, Jul 10, 2026 at 9:15 AM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick escalation for executive approval. NovaCorp is ready to commit to a 12-month contract but requires premium support included and a scoped integration (custom connector to their internal data lake).

Thanks for the summary, Aditya. A couple of quick questions before I can escalate to Finance for sign-off: 
- Please attach a P&L / margin impact for the first 12 months showing the effect of the 20% discount + 80 hours onboarding credit.
- Confirm whether the 80 hours are capped as a credit (we absorb cost) or will be billed at T&M after the credit is used.
- Legal needs the SOW to call out a "change order" process for any custom development beyond the 80 hours.

As a shortcut option: we might approve including Premium Support (first year) and reduce the onboarding credit to 40 hours covered, with a 15% discount instead of 20%. That reduces cash impact while keeping the commercial concession visible to the customer.

If you can answer the bullets and push an updated order form to Legal (cc me), I can present an approval recommendation to Finance by Monday.

-Rishi
Director, Deal Desk
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elenatorres@novacorp.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Non-standard commercial approval for NovaCorp - onboarding + premium support

Thanks Rishi — answers below and updated materials attached.

1) Margin impact (first 12 months):
- List ARR: $370,000
- Proposed committed ARR: $300,000 (20% discount year 1)
- Gross margin (service + infra assumptions): approx. 58% at list price; with discount and absorbed onboarding credit estimated blended margin = 46% first year
- Onboarding credit estimate: 80 hours x $500/hour internal cost = $40,000 one-time absorption

2) Onboarding credit framing: Redwood would absorb up to 80 hours as a one-time onboarding credit. Any additional scope will be billed at standard engineering rates subject to a signed change order.

3) SOW / change control: SOW attached (NovaCorp_SOW_v1.pdf) includes a section for change orders and a cap on out-of-scope deliverables. I also uploaded a clean Order_Form (Order_Form_NovaCorp-20260710.docx) with the revised commercial terms.

Rationale recap: NovaCorp is a referenceable account in our target vertical (financial services tooling) and is piloting three additional integrations contingent on a smooth initial onboarding. We believe the 20% concession + onboarding credit will materially increase likelihood of expansion in 9–12 months.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/54321
DocuSign (order draft): https://redwood.app/docusign/NV-2026-0710-01

If approved, I'll ask Legal to push the signed OF to Procurement and schedule a kickoff with CS next week.

—Aditya

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elenatorres@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Non-standard commercial approval for NovaCorp - onboarding + premium support

Team —

Thank you for the clear write-up. I approve the request with the following conditions: 

1) Approve a maximum 18% discount to be applied to the first-year committed ARR (slightly lower than proposed).
2) Approve inclusion of Premium Support (first year) at no additional charge.
3) Approve an onboarding credit up to 60 hours (not 80) — anything beyond 60 hours requires Finance approval and will be subject to a change order at standard rates.
4) Legal: update the Order Form to include a defined scope appendix and a change-order approval workflow. No open-ended "custom dev" commitments.
5) This approval is timeboxed: sign-off expires in 7 calendar days unless we receive a countersigned order.

Rationale: preserves commercial competitiveness while limiting near-term margin erosion. Aditya, present the revised order form (18% discount / 60h credit) to the customer and push to Procurement; Rishi, please run final margin impact and confirm with Finance that onboarding credit <= $30k is allowable under current credit policy.

Once Legal has the final OF, I'll provide an exec signature.

—Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elenatorres@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Non-standard commercial approval for NovaCorp - onboarding + premium support

Thanks — noted. CS will scope the integration to confirm 60 hours is sufficient. Initial plan: 40 hours for connector development + 10 hours testing + 10 hours knowledge transfer and hypercare. If we identify additional risk, we will flag by EOD Wednesday and route for Finance approval.

I'll attach a short resource plan once scoped.

—Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
